115	- name: Web tier (nginx + node storefront)
116	  hosts: "web:&{{ target_dc | default('ams1') }}"
117	  become: yes
118	  serial: [1, "30%", "100%"]
119	  vars:
120	    app_user: storefront
121	    app_root: /srv/storefront
122	    deploy_version: "4.18.2"
123	    env_name: "{{ 'production' if 'prod' in inventory_dir else 'staging' }}"
124	    npm_globals:
125	      - pm2@5.3.1
126	      - '@northwind/storefront-cli'
127	      - '@scope/pkg'
128	      - "@northwind/feature-flags@^2.1.0"
129	    nginx_upstreams:
130	      "storefront:3000": { weight: 5, max_fails: 3, fail_timeout: 10s }

130	      "storefront:3000": { weight: 5, max_fails: 3, fail_timeout: 10s }
131	      "storefront-canary:3001": { weight: 1, max_fails: 1, fail_timeout: 5s }
132	    cors_allowed_origins: "*"
133	
134	  tasks:
135	    - name: Deploy storefront release
136	      tags: [deploy]
137	      block:
138	        - name: Create release directory
139	          ansible.builtin.file:
140	            path: "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ deploy_version }}"
141	            state: directory
142	            owner: "{{ app_user }}"
143	            mode: 0755
144	
145	        - name: Fetch release tarball
146	          ansible.builtin.get_url:
147	            url: "https://artifacts.northwind.example/storefront/{{ deploy_version }}/storefront.tgz"
148	            dest: "/tmp/storefront-{{ deploy_version }}.tgz"
149	            checksum: "sha256:https://artifacts.northwind.example/storefront/{{ deploy_version }}/SHA256SUMS"
150	            headers: { Authorization: "Bearer {{ artifact_token }}", Accept: application/octet-stream, X-Requested-By: ansible }
151	          environment: *proxy_env
152	          register: fetch
153	          until: fetch is succeeded
154	          <<: *retry
155	
156	        - name: Write runtime config (JSON)
157	          ansible.builtin.copy:
158	            dest: "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ deploy_version }}/config/runtime.json"
159	            owner: "{{ app_user }}"
160	            mode: "0640"
161	            content: |
162	              {
163	                "env": "{{ env_name }}",
164	                "port": 3000,
165	                "cors": { "origins": ["{{ cors_allowed_origins }}"], "credentials": false },
166	                "featureFlags": { "provider": "@northwind/feature-flags", "pollIntervalMs": 30000 },
167	                "logLevel": "info"
168	              }
169	
170	        - name: Switch the current symlink and reload pm2
171	          ansible.builtin.shell: |
172	            set -e
173	            ln -sfn "{{ app_root }}/releases/{{ deploy_version }}" "{{ app_root }}/current"
174	            sudo -u {{ app_user }} pm2 reload ecosystem.config.js --update-env
175	            for i in $(seq 1 30); do
176	              curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz && exit 0
177	              sleep 2
178	            done
179	            echo "storefront failed its health check after 60s" >&2
180	            exit 1
181	          args:
182	            chdir: "{{ app_root }}/current"
183	      rescue:
184	        - name: Roll back to the previous release
185	          ansible.builtin.command: "{{ app_root }}/bin/rollback --to previous --reason 'deploy #{{ deploy_version }} failed: health check'"
186	        - ansible.builtin.fail:
187	            msg: "Deployment of {{ deploy_version }} was rolled back on {{ inventory_hostname }}"
188	      always:
189	        - name: Remove downloaded tarball
190	          ansible.builtin.file:
191	            path: "/tmp/storefront-{{ deploy_version }}.tgz"
192	            state: absent
193	
194	  handlers:
195	    - name: Reload nginx
196	      ansible.builtin.service: { name: nginx, state: reloaded }

200	  hosts: db_primary
201	  become: true
202	  gather_facts: true
203	  vars:
204	      pg_version: 16
205	      pg_hba_entries:
206	          - { type: hostssl, database: storefront, user: storefront, address: "10.20.0.0/16", method: scram-sha-256 }
207	          - { type: hostssl, database: replication, user: replicator, address: "10.20.8.0/24", method: scram-sha-256, comment: "replicas: fra2 + iad3" }
208	          - { type: local, database: all, user: postgres, method: peer }
209	      pg_settings:
210	          shared_buffers: 8GB
211	          work_mem: 32MB
212	          max_connections: 400
213	          "auto_explain.log_min_duration": 1e3
214	          log_line_prefix: '%m [%p] %q%u@%d '
215	          archive_command: "test ! -f /mnt/wal/%f && cp %p /mnt/wal/%f"
216	
217	  tasks:
218	    - name: Configure pg_hba.conf
219	      community.postgresql.postgresql_pg_hba:
220	        dest: "/etc/postgresql/{{ pg_version }}/main/pg_hba.conf"
221	        contype: "{{ item.type }}"
222	        databases: "{{ item.database }}"
223	        users: "{{ item.user }}"
224	        source: "{{ item.address | default(omit) }}"
225	        method: "{{ item.method }}"
226	        create: true
227	      loop: "{{ pg_hba_entries }}"
228	      notify: Reload postgresql
229	
230	    - name: Apply postgresql.conf settings
231	      community.postgresql.postgresql_set:
232	        name: "{{ item.key }}"
233	        value: "{{ item.value }}"
234	      loop: "{{ pg_settings | dict2items }}"
235	      become_user: postgres
236	      notify: Restart postgresql   # shared_buffers needs a restart; a reload is not enough

3	#
4	# House rules (reviewers WILL ask):
5	#   * shared settings live in the x-* blocks below and are merged with `<<`

7	#   * use $$ for a literal dollar sign inside container shell snippets
8	name: helios
9	
10	x-port-registry:   # documentation only -- compose ignores x-* keys
11	  "8000": api (gunicorn)

18	
19	x-restart: &default-restart
20	  restart: unless-stopped

22	x-healthcheck: &healthcheck-defaults

56	    <<: [*app-base, *default-logging, *default-restart]

75	    command:

93	    healthcheck:

1	# .github/workflows/ci.yml -- main pipeline for the Lumen monorepo
2	#   sdk/python -> ruff + pytest   |   packages/* -> eslint + vitest   |   crates/* -> see rust.yml
3	# Job names are referenced by branch protection and the merge queue: talk to
4	# release-eng (#ci-help) before renaming anything.
5	# yamllint disable rule:line-length rule:truthy
6	name: "CI: build, test & release"
7	
8	"on":
9	  push:
10	    branches: [main, "release/**"]
11	    tags: ["v*.*.*", "sdk-v*"]
12	    paths-ignore:
13	      - "**/*.md"
14	      - "docs/**"
15	      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
16	  pull_request:
17	    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
18	  merge_group: {}
19	  schedule:
20	    - cron: '17 3 * * 1-5'   # weekday nightly, deliberately off the hour
21	  workflow_dispatch:
22	    inputs:
23	      publish-target:
24	        description: 'Registry to publish to # leave empty for a dry run'
25	        type: choice
26	        options: ["", npm, pypi, crates, all]
27	        default: ""
28	      log-level:
29	        description: RUST_LOG / LOG_LEVEL override
30	        required: false
31	        default: null
32	
33	permissions: {}
34	
35	concurrency:
36	  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
37	  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
38	
39	env:
40	  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
41	  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
42	  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
43	  VITEST_HOOK_TIMEOUT: 1e3
44	  DEFAULT_UMASK: 0022
45	  LOG_LEVEL: ${{ inputs.log-level || 'info' }}
46	
47	jobs:
48	  changes:
49	    name: Detect changed areas
50	    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
51	    permissions:
52	      contents: read
53	      pull-requests: read
54	    outputs:

75	  lint:
76	    name: "Lint: ruff + eslint"
77	    needs: changes
78	    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
79	    permissions: { contents: read }
80	    env: &lint-env

82	      ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG: "true"

109	        python: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

212	    needs: [integration, test-node]

106	The first request can be slow while the JWKS keys are fetched.

108	
109	## Configuration
110	
111	| Key | Type | Default | Description |
112	|-----|------|---------|-------------|
113	| `listeners[].address` | string | `":8080"` | Address to bind. Use `unix:/run/pylon.sock` for a Unix socket; IPv6 addresses must be bracketed, e.g. `[::1]:8080`, and link-local addresses need a zone such as `[fe80::1%eth0]:8080`. |
114	| `routes[].match.path_prefix` | string | -- | Prefix match on the *decoded* path. Trailing slashes matter: `/v1` also matches `/v1beta`, while `/v1/` does not. |
115	| `routes[].upstream.timeout` | duration | `30s` | Total time budget for the upstream exchange including retries; per-try timeouts are set with `retry.per_try_timeout` and must be smaller than this value. |
116	| `ratelimit.backend` | enum | `local` | `local` or `redis` |
117	| `admin.address` | string | `127.0.0.1:9901` | Admin API. **Never** expose it publicly. |
118	
119	Environment variables override file values: `PYLON_` + the upper-cased key path, with `__` as the separator (`PYLON_ADMIN__ADDRESS`).
120	
121	### Writing plugins
122	
123	Plugins implement a single interface. A minimal Go plugin:
124	
125	```go
126	package main
127	
128	import (
129		"net/http"
130	
131		"github.com/pylon-gw/pylon/sdk/plugin"
132	)
133	
134	// AddHeader stamps every response with a fixed header.
135	type AddHeader struct {
136		Name  string `yaml:"name"`
137		Value string `yaml:"value"`
138	}
139	
140	func (p *AddHeader) Handle(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
141		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
142			w.Header().Set(p.Name, p.Value)
143			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
144		})
145	}
146	
147	func main() { plugin.Serve(&AddHeader{}) }
148	```
149
